name: cursor-touch-bar
description: Touch Bar buttons for Cursor: panels, chat, modes, and your own skills.

touchBar.when: cursorTouchBar.page == modes || cursorTouchBar.page == skills || cursorTouchBar.page == layout || cursorTouchBar.page == chat || cursorTouchBar.page == review || cursorTouchBar.page == general

cursorTouchBar.showConfigButton.description: Show the gear button that opens Cursor Touch Bar settings on the main row.

cursorTouchBar.showNextStackLogo.description: Show the N3XTTECH logo next to the settings button on the main row.

cursorTouchBar.buttons.description: Touch Bar buttons in order. Each one runs a command or opens another row.

slot1.description: Left panel. Show or hide the left sidebar.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

spaceBefore.description: Leave a gap before this button. Off groups it with the button on its left.
